integrity: Exact symbolic reconstruction of printed Equations (6), (8), and (9) against the published Section 5 diffusion. Corrected strong and weak formulas and an explicit independent constant-diffusion weak-form witness are supplied. No unverified claims about implementation or external validation.
scientific_limitations: Local operator identities; no conclusion is drawn about unpublished numerical implementation or whether a correct PDE was discretized.
The weak residual witness is posed in an interior rectangle and tested by compact support; it is not a global no-flux probability solution.
The modified-drift interpretation applies to Equation (8) when it is supplied with its own natural conservative flux.
The printed proof through Equation (9) does not certify equivalence with Equation (6), but a separate valid proof is not excluded.
title: A variance-gradient drift defect in the published Fokker–Planck epidemic control formulation
